script: A light-year is a distance, not a length of time. It is how far light travels in one year. That is about 9.5 trillion kilometers. The nearest star after the Sun is about 4.2 light-years away. Driving there at highway speed would take tens of millions of years. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
